# Multiple Languages

## Python

```python
def add(a, b):
    return a + b
```

## JavaScript

```javascript
function add(a, b) {
  return a + b;
}
```

## Rust

```rust
fn add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {
    a + b
}
```

## Go

```go
func add(a, b int) int {
    return a + b
}
```

## SQL

```sql
SELECT * FROM users WHERE active = true;
```
